source_document.body:
We’ve got power station sales and tool lows filling this week’s Green Deals kickstart, starting with Bluetti’s fresh Halloween Sale lineup that has deals like the 2026 Elite 300 3,014Wh Portable Power Station down at $1,099 , as well as larger Anker SOLIX E10 Whole-Home Backup System deals starting from an exclusive $3,799 low . From there, we have EGO’s highly advanced 22-inch Select Cut and Touch Drive mower with a 10.0Ah battery back at its best 2026 price with $390 savings, next to the brand’s 880 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower with 2x batteries at its $307 low . There’s also the 60V Greenworks 20-inch Cordless Snow Blower at a new low price, and all the hangover deals from last week rounded up in our latest Electrified Weekly edition .
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Bluetti Halloween Sale cuts $600 off ‘world’s smallest 3kWh power station’ for $1,099, more from $465
Bluetti has switched over to its full Halloween Sale for the rest of October , complete with our exclusive bonus savings code 9TO5TOYS5OFF and some FREE gifts on orders over $1,000, not to mention a lot of units provide 2x Bluetti bucks. Among some of the most popular options for backup power support is the 2026 Elite 300 3,014Wh Portable Power Station down at $1,099 shipped , which seems to be the one offer that you can’t stack our exclusive bonus savings code onto, but does beat out Amazon by $600 . Amazon is keeping it at its $1,699 MSRP, with this deal giving you $600 savings cut from the tag, which we’ve only seen beaten by falls to $1,044 in the past, as well as the one-time falls to $1,000 and the $999 low during the two Prime Day events in June and at the top of the month. Head below to check out the full lineup while it lasts through the week.
***Note: The exclusive bonus savings have not been added into any of the prices you see below, so be sure to use our code 9TO5TOYS5OFF at checkout for the best deals during this sale.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Top picks from Bluetti’s Halloween Sale lineup:
Elite 100 V2 (1,024Wh) power station: $489 (Reg. $499)
FridgePower (2,016Wh) with Display1: $948 (Reg. $999)
Elite 300 (3,014Wh) power station: $1,099 (Reg. $1,699)
Elite 400 (3,840Wh) power station: $1,399 (Reg. $1,799)
Elite 300 (3,014Wh) with Solar & Alternator Charger 2: $1,439 (Reg. $1,599)
Apex 300 (2,764.8Wh) power station: $1,599 (Reg. $1,699)
FridgePower (4,032Wh) with BC200 battery: $1,699 (Reg. $1,799)
Elite 300 (3,014Wh) with 500W solar panel: $1,898 (Reg. $2,048)
Apex 300 (2,764.8Wh) with 350W solar panel: $2,069 (Reg. $2,348)
Apex 300 (7,884.8Wh) with B500K battery: $3,299 (Reg. $3,699)
5kWh RV Kit (5.12kWh): $3,699 (Reg. $3,999)
There are many more Bluetti Halloween deals to shop on the main sale page here , including the add-on accessory units.
EGO’s 22-inch Select Cut + Touch Drive cordless mower with 10.0Ah battery hits best price of the year at $390 off
We just spotted Amazon offering the advanced package for the EGO Power+ 22-inch Cordless Electric Select Cut and Touch Drive Self-Propelled Lawn Mower with a 10.0Ah battery down at $909 shipped . Down from $1,299, we’ve seen discounts in 2026 to $1,099 and a bunch of short-term falls to this same rate. While it has gone lower to $839 in the past, you’re looking at a solid $390 markdown for the lowest price we’ve tracked this year and the second-lowest price overall. You can also find varying battery bundle options for it on the same landing page.
You can learn all about this premium EGO mower package in our coverage of this deal here .
Upgrade to Anker’s SOLIX E10 whole-home backup system at best prices starting from exclusive $3,799 + FREE gifts
Alongside Anker’s main Spooktacular Halloween power station sale , you can currently find the brand’s E10 Whole-Home Backup System getting major savings , complete with FREE gifts and our exclusive bonus savings code. Things start with the standard 6kWh base setup of a module and a battery at $3,799.05 shipped , after using the code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout, beating out Amazon by $800 . This system carries a $4,299 MSRP these days, though Amazon has seen the full price up as high as $4,599. This same price first appeared during June’s Prime Day event and repeated again during October’s event, with you getting a third chance here. The exclusive deal gives you $500 combined savings for the all-time lowest price we have tracked. Head below to browse its larger setups and bundles.
As I mentioned, there are some FREE gifts/perks for going with one of the system’s larger bundle units, though all purchases get a free metal pad and AC generator adapter ($268 value). From there, the brand offers up to 60 months of financing for this system, as well as 2x free 440W rigid solar panels ($1,298 value) with purchases of $10,000 or more, while purchases over $15,000 get a free B6000 battery module ($2,499 value).
***Note: We haven’t included any of the exclusive bonus savings into the prices you see below, so be sure to use our code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout for the absolute best prices during this sale.
Top picks from Anker’s SOLIX E10 lineup:
E10 standard system (6kWh) with 1x power module and 1x battery: $3,999 (Reg. $4,299)
E10 system (12kWh) with 1x module and 2x batteries: $5,999 (Reg. $6,299)
E10 system (12kWh) with 1x module, 2x batteries, and a Smart Inlet Box: $6,299 (Reg. $6,599)
E10 system (12kWh) with 1x module, 2x batteries, and Power Dock: $7,799 (No initial price cut)
E10 system (12kWh) with 1x module, 2x batteries, Power Dock, and Smart Generator 5,500: $9,399 (No initial price cut)
E10 system (12kWh) with 10x 440W rigid solar panels: $9,498 (Reg. $9,798)
2x E10 systems (12kWh each) with 2x modules, 4x batteries, and Power Dock: $13,798 (Reg. $14,098)
Of course, there are many more options that you can browse on the main sale page here , just don’t forget to use our exclusive bonus savings code at checkout.
Grab EGO’s most powerful 880 CFM cordless electric leaf blower with 2x batteries at its $307 low ($72 off)
Amazon is returning the powerful EGO Power+ 880 CFM Cordless Electric Leaf Blower with 2x 4.0Ah batteries back down to $307 shipped . While it had a $399 MSRP up until the end of March, since then it’s only climbed as high as $379, with discounts having seen multiple short-term drops to this same rate from late July to the first week of September. Now, the deal has come back around, cutting $72 off the tag for the all-time lowest price we have tracked.
Expand your 60V Greenworks arsenal with this 20-inch cordless snow blower + 4.0Ah battery at a new $464 low, more
Amazon is currently offering the Greenworks 60V 20-inch Cordless Electric Snow Blower with a 4.0Ah battery for $463.99 shipped , which matches the price direct from the brand’s website . Down from $580, this newer-generation package has only been dropped as low as $537 with discounts so far, while the deal here gives you a larger $116 markdown for a new all-time low price. If you have an 80V arsenal from this brand, you can find the 80V 20-inch counterpart with a 4.0Ah battery down at a $450 low right now, too.
